title: Search jobs
intro: Your agent goes through your job boards and adds the jobs that fit you.
introHint: It only reads: it never applies for you. It searches in a separate window where you see what it does, and it can take several minutes.

perPortal.hint: Changes it at once for all the chosen job boards and for the ones you add. On each job board, your agent adds the most recent jobs that fit your profile, up to that number. To change a single job board, go to “Where to search”.

settings.introHint: Saved in your profile. Each block is saved on its own.
settings.rule: Each filter applies only when the job states that detail.
